args.title: Use configured application URL for password reset email links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the configured public application URL from `config.appUrl` or similar configuration instead of `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` with a hardcoded `localhost:3000` fallback so password reset emails point to the correct production domain.
